title: Fix a hardcoded wrong table name in the ticket-created logging business-logic fu
description:
[The user currently has the "Ticket Management" screen open (object support360_ticket_assignment, type T). Resolve "this", "this form/page/screen", or "here" to this object unless they name a different one.]

Also, the "ticket created" log step writes to the table SUPPORT360_TICKET_ACTIVITY_LOG, but the real table is SUPPORT360_TICKET_ACTLOG. Please correct the table name there.
